description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components capable of outputting log messages, potentially chaining multiple log targets together. It declares a single method, println, for printing log entries with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node in a chain, capable of outputting log messages and passing them along to subsequent nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, designed to be implemented by classes that handle logging output.
